page.overview:
Who is Night Patrol Deity?

The is a god tasked with monitoring people during the night.

Sun Wukong summoned the Night Patrol Deity to make a request for Heaven to help him trick some demons into thinking he owns a magic gourd.

Later, the Night Patrol Deity facilitated the resurrection of the king of the Black Rooster Kingdom by allowing his ghost to appear to Tang Sanzang in a dream. He also informed the Dragon King of the Well that Zhu Bajie would be arriving to collect the king's body.

Category:Males Category:Gods Category:Taoism
